original_item: Prove completed failed and cancelled delivery
historical_disposition: The old completed checklist item is not evidence of automatic cancelled delivery. That notification criterion is explicitly superseded, never recorded as PASS.
approval: Owner explicitly instructed this local closure pass to preserve OMP suppression and adopt the replacement cancellation-accounting criterion.
reason: Automatic notification delivery and trustworthy durable cancellation accounting are distinct requirements; OMP intentionally suppresses automatic cancelled-result delivery.
replacement_requirement: On a host that suppresses automatic cancelled-result delivery, Brain must not depend on such a message. Where an authorized structured host interface exposes a cancellation acknowledgement or terminal cancellation state, Brain must reconcile it to the exact bound task and record its provenance idempotently. Where the outcome is no longer observable, Brain must record bounded unresolved/expired state rather than inventing cancellation, success, or failure. No stale task may hold Brain-owned scheduling capacity indefinitely or authorize duplicate execution, success credit, or unsafe promotion. Host notification policy remains unchanged.
retained_safety: Exact parent-session, packet, native-job and expected-child binding
Preserved unfinished scope and unknown usage
Logical cancellation is not proof of executor termination or cleanup
No duplicate execution, unsafe resource release, success credit or promotion
Bounded honest recovery when authority is unavailable
required_proof: All twelve scenarios in the supplied Cancellation-to-Qualification plan section B4, with real native lifecycle and Brain persistence; executor stubs explicitly disclosed.
